<function name="TableToKeyValues" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Converts the given table into a Valve keyValue formatted string.

Use <page>util.KeyValuesToTable</page> to perform the opposite transformation.

<page>util.TableToJSON</page> can be used as an alternative.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="table" type="table">The table to convert.</arg>
		<arg name="rootKey" type="string" default="TableToKeyValues">The root key name for the output KV table.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The output.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
